stops.name: cpu
stops.mechanism: RLIMIT_CPU (setrlimit) + SIGXCPU, SIGKILL at the hard limit

stops.name: wall
stops.mechanism: an in-child watchdog thread that calls os._exit, inside the launcher's own -t limit
stops.outer_stop: the launcher's -t wall limit, which does not depend on the child

stops.name: host_envelope
stops.mechanism: the cgroup's MemoryMax, set by the launcher; the kernel kills the tree

stops.name: device_envelope
stops.mechanism: tf.config.set_logical_device_configuration, predeclared before device init: an oversized request fails with ResourceExhaustedError where it is made
stops.not_this: an allocator statistic compared later, which is OBSERVED_AFTER_THE_FACT

stops.name: stage:probe
stops.mechanism: setitimer(ITIMER_REAL) for the stage wall and a CPU poll that exits

stops_declared.reading: each row names the mechanism that stops the run. A budget with no mechanism is not a stop and does not appear here

cpu_stop.name: cpu
cpu_stop.mechanism: RLIMIT_CPU (setrlimit) + SIGXCPU, SIGKILL at the hard limit
cpu_stop.hard_stop: SIGKILL at the hard limit, which the child cannot decline

wall_stop.name: wall
wall_stop.mechanism: an in-child watchdog thread that calls os._exit at the deadline
wall_stop.outer_stop: the launcher's own -t wall limit and the supervisor's timeout
